In Table 7, the Federal Reserve notes to be collateralized total **$2,420,559 million**. Of this, the gold certificate account ($11,037 million) and the special drawing rights certificate account ($15,200 million) together cover $26,237 million, while the remaining **$2,394,322 million** is covered by pledged securities.

This means pledged securities cover:

**$2,394,322 million ÷ $2,420,559 million ≈ 98.9%** of the Federal Reserve notes to be collateralized — with the gold and SDR certificate accounts covering the remaining roughly 1.1%.
